finalists.label: Takotsubo syndrome
finalists.why: The candidate has specific evidence of akinesia of all apical segments, later extending to mid-segments, hyperkinesia of the basal segments, and severely reduced LVEF of 35%, which is unique to this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Acute Coronary Syndrome
finalists.why: The candidate has a broad range of evidence including Canadian Cardiovascular Society Class III angina, patent stents, and ST-segment elevation, which are common to several diagnoses but fit this one well.

finalists.label: Coronary Artery Disease
finalists.why: The candidate has a strong evidence base including hypertension, dyslipidaemia, stage 3 chronic kidney disease, active smoking, and prior percutaneous coronary interventions, which are all risk factors for this condition.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and unique evidence, including akinesia of all apical segments and severely reduced LVEF, which are distinctive features of Takotsubo syndrome.
